description: Source code for the ElementsUploadDataStream class, which manages upload data streams composed of multiple upload element readers, including initialization, reading, and memory checks.

classes.name: ElementsUploadDataStream
classes.description: Manages a stream of upload elements, supporting initialization, reading, and memory status checks.

methods.name: CreateWithReader
methods.description: Creates a new ElementsUploadDataStream with a single upload element reader.

methods.name: ReadInternal
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer.

methods.name: IsInMemory
methods.description: Checks if all upload elements are in memory.

methods.name: GetElementReaders
methods.description: Returns the list of upload element readers.

methods.name: ResetInternal
methods.description: Resets internal state and invalidates weak pointers.

methods.name: InitElements
methods.description: Initializes all upload element readers starting from a given index.

methods.name: OnInitElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of initializing an individual element.

methods.name: ReadElements
methods.description: Reads data from the current upload element into the buffer.

methods.name: OnReadElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of reading an individual element.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a read operation, updating buffer consumption or error state.
